queries: WITH s AS (SELECT st.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS r, COUNT(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites st ON sc.zoneref = st.zoneregistry GROUP BY st.healtheval), g AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s WHERE r IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(s.r) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(s.r - g.a) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN g WHERE s.r > g.a

WITH g AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(1.0*sc.gbsize/NULLIF(sc.spanmin,0)) AS rate, COUNT(1.0*sc.gbsize/NULLIF(sc.spanmin,0)) AS cnt FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(g.rate - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.rate > o.overall

WITH st AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS cnt FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), x AS (SELECT healtheval, rate, cnt, AVG(rate) OVER () AS overall FROM st WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(rate - overall) AS avg_excess FROM x WHERE rate > overall

assumptions.assumption: A status's rate is the mean of per-scan gbsize/spanmin. Scans with a null gbsize or spanmin, or a zero spanmin (treated as missing), are ignored.
The 'average across all statuses' is the unweighted mean of the per-status average rates, so each status counts once.
A status's 'count' is the number of its matched scans that have a valid rate.
Sites with a NULL healtheval form one group, and that group counts as a status if it has a valid rate.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-status average is the overall mean rate across all matched scans (scan-weighted), not the mean of the status averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT st.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS r, COUNT(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites st ON sc.zoneref = st.zoneregistry GROUP BY st.healtheval), g AS (SELECT AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS a FROM scans sc JOIN sites st ON sc.zoneref = st.zoneregistry) SELECT AVG(s.r) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(s.r - g.a) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN g WHERE s.r > g.a

assumptions.assumption: A status's rate is the mean of per-scan gbsize/spanmin ratios. Scans with a null gbsize or null or zero spanmin are ignored.
The all-status average is the unweighted mean of the per-status rates, not a scan-weighted mean. A null healtheval counts as its own group.
'Count' means the number of matched scans with a valid rate in each status, and the result averages that across the qualifying statuses.

alternatives.interpretation: A status's rate is total gbsize divided by total spanmin (a ratio of sums) over scans with both values present and a nonzero spanmin. The count is the number of those scans.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT si.healtheval, 1.0*SUM(sc.gbsize)/SUM(sc.spanmin) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(g.rate - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.rate > o.overall
